scope.summary: Implement StudioVariable (hsk.studio.variable@1) as the single design-token primitive with the normative four-type set: Color (value carrying an explicit StudioColorProfile ref), Number (typed numeric with unit), String (text), Boolean (true/false). Every variable resolves to exactly one value per active mode of its owning collection (MT-347). There is no separate prototype-only variable type; the same primitive is shared with 14.11 (MT-383).
acceptance_criteria: StudioVariable with color/number/string/boolean types; one value per active mode; shared with prototyping
expected_tests: live: all four variable types round-trip through authority; each resolves one value per active mode

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No design-token primitive; variables and prototype logic have no shared value type.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
